reference.title: Page rendering and generated files
reference.shortdesc: See how DITA topic content, theme styles, and generated output files are handled by the Python adapter and Zensical.

section.title: Topic pages

ul.li: Page metadata becomes front matter for title, description, and keywords.
Section titles become Markdown headings with their DITA IDs. Zensical uses them for the page outline, permalinks, and section search results.
Wrappers that contain headings are removed. A section ID moves to its title or to an empty div.dita-anchor, so cross-references still have a target.

Other topic markup remains raw HTML, written as one block per line. Newlines inside pre elements become 
.
Cross-page links become relative URLs for Zensical's directory-style routes. Local image paths are adjusted for those routes.

section.p: Python-Markdown passes top-level raw HTML through without parsing it. The md_in_html extension parses nested HTML inside marked containers, which can change DITA task markup.

ul.li: DITA notes become div.admonition elements with a note type and title.
DITA table classes are moved to data-dita-class, because the theme styles class-less tables.
The generated DITA stylesheet covers DITA classes that the theme does not style.

section.title: Generated labels
section.p: The plug-in sets args.gen.task.lbl to YES, so task sections get headings, and it replaces the DITA-OT English labels with Red Hat ones. The labels come from resources/strings/strings-en-us.xml, which the plug-in registers through the dita.xsl.strings extension point.

row.entry: Related concepts, Related tasks, Related reference, Related information

section.p: DITA-OT groups related links by the type of the target topic and gives each group its own heading. The plug-in puts concept, task, and reference links in the untyped group, so each topic has one "Additional resources" list. Concept and reference topics generate no other section labels. Their section headings come from the section titles in the content.
To build without task labels, pass -Dargs.gen.task.lbl=NO.

section.p: At the start of a build, the plug-in removes interchange/ or docs/ only when that output directory contains the plug-in's .dita-zensical marker. If either path exists without the marker, the build stops instead of deleting files it does not own.
